The '''Kalindan Royal Research Facility''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]] in the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]]. Around two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], they were working on [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] countermeasures.
